

// package main






#[allow(non_snake_case)]
fn Void() -> i32 { 7 }
struct Fixture;
impl Fixture { #[allow(non_snake_case)] fn Void(&self) -> i32 { 8 } }

fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        
let plain = Void()
;



let fixture = Fixture;



let method = fixture.Void()

;



let Void = String::from("value");



let length = Void.len()

;



assert_eq!(plain, 7); assert_eq!(method, 8); assert_eq!(length, 5);



    
}
